tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_6.csv')

# For each (account, service), compute median and MAD to detect outliers
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
med = g.transform('median')
mad = (df['BilledCost'] - med).abs()
mad_med = mad.groupby([df['SubAccountName'], df['ServiceName']]).transform('median')
z = (df['BilledCost'] - med) / (mad_med * 1.4826 + 1e-9)
df['z'] = z
top = df.nlargest(10, 'z')
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
